# Norwegian synthetic acceptance audio

`norwegian-synthetic.wav` is generated locally with the installed Windows Microsoft Jon (`nb-NO`) voice, 16 kHz mono PCM16. It contains no microphone recording, personal meeting, or third-party source recording. The authoring text is a test fixture:

> Dette er en test av lokal norsk transkripsjon. Vi bestemmer at det reviderte utkastet skal sendes før fredag. Martin legger ved søkeloggen.

Use for local CPU transcription and fake-device capture tests. It does not establish real microphone or loopback quality. Windows voice licensing applies to the synthesizer; this repository does not redistribute the voice engine.
